en.headline: 9 own commits plus 15 automated commits across two repositories
en.summary: **9 own commits** were recorded across two repositories, alongside 15 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, eight commits updated VS Code extension recommendations and formatting, adjusted `.gitignore` rules for `.history` and daily scripts, documented error handling in `generate-activity.mjs`, and refactored diagnostics to deduplicate probes with headers, catch failures, and reduce concurrent duplicate requests. One commit in `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` expanded the agent documentation with the documentation-site workflow and branch self-checks. The user opened or closed **1 issue**: issue `#5584` in `openchamber/openchamber`, titled “[Bug] Quote card's arrow is a silent no-op when the quoted message is outside the loaded history”. `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied to that issue with a `fix-ready` note indicating the cause had been traced. The user also closed issue `#5556` in `openchamber/openchamber`, titled “[Bug] Files view: dragging across line numbers to comment is unreliable (web, desktop, VS Code extension)”, while `btriapitsyn` was recorded as the actor.

zh.headline: 两个仓库共 9 次本人提交，另有 15 次自动提交
zh.summary: 当天在两个仓库完成 **9 次本人提交**，另有 15 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 8 次提交更新了 VS Code 推荐扩展清单并格式化配置，调整 `.gitignore` 对 `.history` 和日报脚本目录的忽略规则，为 `generate-activity.mjs` 的错误处理补充注释，并重构诊断逻辑，使探测去重键包含 headers、增加 catch 兜底并减少并发重复请求。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 1 次提交为 agent 文档补充文档站工作流与分支自检。用户新开或关闭了 **1 个 issue**：在 `openchamber/openchamber` 新开 `#5584`“[Bug] Quote card's arrow is a silent no-op when the quoted message is outside the loaded history”。`openchamber-bot[bot]` 回复该 issue，给出 `fix-ready` 标记并说明已定位原因。用户还关闭了 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 `#5556`“[Bug] Files view: dragging across line numbers to comment is unreliable (web, desktop, VS Code extension)”，记录中的操作者为 `btriapitsyn`。
